title: Ever feel like life keeps waving its résumé in your face? 😤
paragraphs:
Ever feel like life keeps waving its résumé in your face? 😤
Goliath tried that too… but I showed up with faith, not credentials. ⚔️✨

The armor isn’t ego — it’s evidence that I’ve been through fire and still shine.
So yeah… I move different. I move like grace got hands. 💪😇

“You come against me with sword and spear, but I come against you in the name of the Lord Almighty.”
— 1 Samuel 17:45
